targets.title: The influence of partner-specific memory associations on language production: Evidence from picture naming.
targets.evidence_quote: This paper presents the results of three experiments designed to replicate and extend Horton's (2007) Experiment 1.
targets.outcome_quote: This paper presents the results of three experiments designed to replicate and extend Horton's (2007) Experiment 1. The original findings were not replicated. These findings do not support the hypothesis that partner-specific memory associations facilitate object naming.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict across close and conceptual replications. Familiarity and memory checks do not change the central partner-specific effect verdict.
